name: Pop-Up
description: The explosive move from lying to standing as you catch the wave. Everything starts here.
cues: Paddle hard, feel the wave take you
Hands flat under the chest, press up
Front foot jumps between the hands in one motion
Land low and centered, eyes down the line
commonMistakes: Coming up to the knees first
Front foot landing too far back

name: Bottom Turn
description: The foundation of every maneuver. Sets your line and stores the energy for the next move.
cues: Look where you want to go
Compress and load through the bottom
Drive off the back foot, weight on the rail
Project up toward the lip or section

name: Cutback
description: Carving back toward the pocket and the wave's power source after racing the open face.
cues: Spot the pocket, that's your target
Lead with the head and shoulders
Carve smoothly, weight on the rail
Come back off the foam to reconnect
commonMistakes: Sliding the tail instead of carving
Not rotating the upper body enough
Looking at the nose instead of the exit

name: Top Turn / Re-Entry
description: Redirecting off the top of the wave back down toward the base.
cues: Use bottom-turn speed to project up
Hit the section with commitment
Pivot off the top, eyes back down
Absorb the drop with bent knees
commonMistakes: Stiff legs on the way down

name: Snap
description: A sharp, vertical redirection off the top of the wave with spray.
cues: Approach vertically with speed
Quick, aggressive rotation off the top
Throw the tail with the back foot
Recover centered and ride out
commonMistakes: Over-rotating and falling off the back

name: Floater
description: Riding over the top of a breaking section to get past it and back down.
cues: Approach the section with speed
Stay light, ride up and over the whitewater
Keep weight centered over the board
Spot your landing and absorb it
commonMistakes: Leaning back on the way up
Not enough speed to carry over
